parallels.note: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.line: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”
translations.bsb: The watchman said, “The first man appears to me to be running like Ahimaaz son of Zadok.” “This is a good man,” said the king. “He comes with good news.”
translations.kjv: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
translations.asv: And the watchman said, I think the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
